metadata.name: mls.createIdentity
metadata.description: (name, suite) — a member's MLS identity: a signed KeyPackage (public) + its private keys.

metadata.name: mls.foundGroup
metadata.description: (groupId, self, suite) — found a new MLS group as its first member; returns the group state.

metadata.name: mls.addMember
metadata.description: (group, memberPublicPackage, suite) — advance the group and emit a Welcome (to the joiner) + commit (to members).

metadata.name: mls.removeMember
metadata.description: (group, leafIndex, suite) — remove a member; advances the epoch so the group key rotates.

metadata.name: mls.joinFromWelcome
metadata.description: (welcome, self, ratchetTree, suite) — join a group from a Welcome message.

metadata.name: mls.applyCommit
metadata.description: (group, commit, suite) — apply another member's commit to advance your state to the new epoch.

metadata.name: mls.resourceDek
metadata.description: (group, resource, suite, length) — derive this group's per-resource DEK at the current epoch (mlsExporter); identical for every member.

metadata.name: mls.epoch
metadata.description: (group) — the current MLS epoch (increments on every commit).

metadata.name: mls.send
metadata.description: (group, plaintext, suite) — encrypt an authenticated application message to the group.

metadata.name: mls.receive
metadata.description: (group, message, suite) — process an incoming group message: application plaintext, or a commit that advances state.
